title: Supabase open-source counter
description: An open-source band: a 34px title, a grey paragraph and a small white button on the left, and on the right a field of tiny square dots (green-tinted in the middle, fading to nothing at the edges) in which a figure such as a star count is spelled in lit green dots. The lit dots switch on column by column, left to right, as the band scrolls into view. Phones centre the text and put the field below.
notes: the dot field is a CSS mask pattern; only the figure's lit dots are elements (a built-in 5×7 dot font: digits, . , K M +)
the reveal is a named CSS view timeline on the field (inside @supports); with reduced motion or without support the figure is simply lit
